product_overview: PeerLearn is a campus peer tutoring and academic collaboration platform for IIITDMJ students. It combines verified student onboarding, academic progress tracking, doubt posting and tutoring, study planning, and campus-wide analytics in one system.
core_goals: Verify only authorized IIITDMJ students can access the platform
Help students monitor academic performance and set realistic CGPA targets
Enable students to post, track, withdraw, and resolve academic doubts
Match qualified peer tutors to doubts and support safe atomic booking
Provide simple task planning tools for daily academic preparation
Surface campus-wide tutoring and system health insights

features.name: Authentication & Onboarding
features.description: Allows new and returning students to securely create accounts, verify institute identity, sign in, and end sessions.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/register/start with valid roll number and institute email -> Receive OTP generation and verification challenge -> POST /api/v1/auth/register/verify with valid OTP and password -> Receive JWT token and authenticated session
POST /api/v1/auth/register/start with roll number not found in academic records -> Receive error response indicating invalid or unknown roll number
POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid institute credentials -> Receive JWT bearer token, user profile, and active session status
POST /api/v1/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive authentication failure response
POST /api/v1/auth/logout with valid session token -> Receive session invalidation confirmation

features.name: Academic Records & Target CGPA
features.description: Displays verified student profile information, academic history, CGPA projections, and lets students update their target CGPA.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/me/profile with authenticated token -> Receive student profile, completed semester count, current CPI, cumulative CGPA, and target projection
PUT /api/v1/me/target with a valid target CGPA between 0.00 and 10.00 -> Receive updated target and required average CPI projection
GET /api/v1/academics/records with authenticated token -> Receive ordered semester-by-semester academic results
PUT /api/v1/me/target with an invalid CGPA outside the allowed range -> Receive validation error response

features.name: Peer Doubts
features.description: Lets students post academic doubts, browse their own doubts, and withdraw unbooked doubts.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/doubts with title, description, expected outcome, and skill IDs -> Receive created doubt with status OPEN and expiration timestamp
GET /api/v1/doubts with authenticated token -> Receive list of the student’s doubts, including active doubts such as OPEN and BOOKED
POST /api/v1/doubts/:id/withdraw for an unbooked authored doubt -> Receive updated status WITHDRAWN
POST /api/v1/doubts/:id/withdraw for a doubt that is already booked or not owned by the requester -> Receive authorization or state error response

features.name: Tutor Matching & Atomic Booking
features.description: Matches tutors to doubts using strict skill requirements and supports concurrency-safe booking of a doubt by one tutor only.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/tutor/doubts with tutor credentials -> Receive only doubts matching all required skills and excluding the tutor’s own doubts
POST /api/v1/matching/tag-stats with selected tags -> Receive matching statistics used to evaluate tutor eligibility and doubt coverage
POST /api/v1/doubts/:id/book with an eligible tutor token -> Receive created tutoring session and doubt status updated to BOOKED
POST /api/v1/doubts/:id/book on a doubt already booked by another tutor -> Receive 409 Conflict indicating the doubt is no longer available

features.name: Study Planner & Tasks
features.description: Supports task creation, priority organization, completion tracking, and marking tasks as tough challenges.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/tasks with title, priority, tough flag, and due date -> Receive created task in the student’s task list
GET /api/v1/tasks with authenticated token -> Receive tasks ordered by priority and date
POST /api/v1/tasks/:id/complete on an incomplete task -> Receive task with completed state toggled to true
POST /api/v1/tasks/:id/toggle-tough on an existing task -> Receive task with is_tough flag toggled
POST /api/v1/tasks with missing or invalid required fields -> Receive validation error response

features.name: Campus Analytics
features.description: Provides aggregated platform statistics for dashboards and analytics pages.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/analytics/overview with authenticated token -> Receive totalDoubts, solvedDoubts, solvedPercentage, and activeTutors
GET /api/v1/analytics/overview when backend data is unavailable -> Receive server error response

features.name: System Health
features.description: Exposes a lightweight readiness and uptime probe for monitoring.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/health -> Receive status ok and timestamp for uptime monitoring
GET /api/v1/health during degraded service -> Receive non-OK health response or server error

code_summary.description: Campus peer tutoring and academic collaboration platform for IIITDMJ students.

key_features.name: Authentication & Onboarding
key_features.description: Two-step registration verifying roll number against authoritative academic records with OTP verification, institute email validation, and JWT session handling.

key_features.name: Academic Records & Target CGPA
key_features.description: Multi-semester CPI tracking, academic performance calculation, and target CGPA projection.

key_features.name: Peer Doubts
key_features.description: Posting academic doubts with subject tags, expected outcomes, expiration windows, and active doubt filtering.

key_features.name: Tutor Matching & Atomic Booking
key_features.description: Strict multi-tag matching for eligible tutors and atomic concurrency-safe booking with PostgreSQL row-level locks.

key_features.name: Study Planner & Tasks
key_features.description: Task creation, priority tagging, tough flag assignment, and completion toggles.

key_features.name: Campus Analytics
key_features.description: Aggregated stats on total doubts, solved doubts, active tutors, and leaderboard rankings.
